WildSpark 2.2.69 is a stable release for WoW Forever.

- Remove WildLayer, including its layer-hop controls and coordination channels, from the active addon. Keep the full licensed source in `archive/WildLayer` for possible future restoration.
- Remove the Leash Timer from the active addon. Keep its source and license in `archive/WildLeashTimer`.
- Keep WildInfo respawn observations connected to WildSpark's existing nameplate and world-entry events without loading the timer.
- Turn off the optional Happy Camper channel listener by default. WildSpark's own Camping Kit sharing remains available on its per-zone channel.
- Wait for built-in game channels before joining WildSpark camping channels, and defer managed-channel cleanup while combat lockdown is active.
- Remove leftover WildLayer `layer…` channel joins once the built-in channels appear.
- Include previously prepared soft-target tracking and WildBuffs caster-detail updates. Custom EllesmereUI aura-bar tooltip behavior remains unverified in the live client.

The release package and workflow checks passed. Live in-game behavior was not tested.
